---
name: Bug Report
about: Report a problem with Neat Core
title: "[Bug] "
labels: bug
assignees: ''
---

## What happened?

Describe the observed behavior and the result you expected. Include the exact
error message and how often the problem occurs.

## How can we reproduce it?

Provide the smallest C++/Python example, tutorial, or command that demonstrates
the problem. For a documentation problem, link the affected page.

## Environment

- Core version, commit, or package reference
- Palette SDK/platform version and host or DevKit used
- Python/pyneat or compiler version, when relevant

## Impact and workaround

Which workflow is affected? Include any workaround or last known working
version, if known.

## Additional diagnostics (optional)

Include only details that help explain the failure, such as model/compiler
versions, MPK manifest fields, tensor shapes/dtypes/layouts, queue settings,
redacted logs, or a stack trace. Use public or synthetic inputs where possible.
Redact credentials, private stream URLs, and customer data.
